[](https://github.com/hedgerowdev/rowan/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](https://www.python.org/downloads/) [](/hedgerowdev/rowan/blob/main/LICENSE) Find security issues in your code and AI/ML projects, with evidence you can review. Rowan reads your project's source code and model files and reports likely vulnerabilities: injection, unsafe deserialization, SSRF, leaked secrets, risky agent tools, unsafe model loading and more. It never runs your code. Alpha. Treat every finding as a lead to check, not a confirmed bug. A clean report does not prove a project is secure. Quick start You need Python 3.10+ and [pipx](https://pipx.pypa.io), which installs commandline tools into their own environment (on macOS: brew install pipx, then pipx ensurepath and open a new terminal). 1\. Install Rowan: pipx install "rowansast[jscrossfile]" Already use uv? uv tool install "rowansast[jscrossfile]" works too. A plain pip install fails on Homebrew Python by design; see [getting started](/hedgerowdev/rowan/blob/main/docs/gettingstarted.md) for a virtualenvironment install. 2\. Install the scan engine ([Opengrep](https://github.com/opengrep/opengrep)) and check it: rowan installengine export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" rowan selftest selftest should print [OK] three times. 3\. Scan a project: rowan scan /path/to/yourproject Windows, troubleshooting and more detail: [getting started](/hedgerowdev/rowan/blob/main/docs/gettingstarted.md). Let your coding agent do it Paste this into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any agent that can run ter

items.descZh: Rowan 是一款专为 AI 应用设计的静态安全扫描工具，专注于检测源代码、模型文件、依赖项以及 agent/MCP 配置中的安全隐患。它采用非运行代码的静态分析技术，能够发现注入、不安全的反序列化、SSRF、泄露的密钥、危险的 agent 工具以及不安全的模型加载等多种漏洞。其核心亮点在于为每一次发现提供详尽的证据链，方便开发者进行人工复核，同时明确提示当前版本为 Alpha 版本，扫描结果应视为待查线索而非最终确认的漏洞。用户可通过 pipx 快速安装，集成 Opengrep 扫描引擎并完成自测（确保输出三次 [OK]）后，即可对指定项目路径进行一键扫描。该工具特别适用于 AI 和 ML 项目的开发阶段、大模型应用的安全审计，以及无缝集成到 Claude Code、Cursor 等编码智能体工作流中。
items.quote: 面向AI应用的静态安全扫描器：源代码、模型文件、依赖项以及 agent/MCP 配置，每个发现均附带证据。

hallmonitorfilmgh.mp4 [Install](install) · [The app](theapp) · [The board](theboard) · [Notch & menu bar](notchmenubar) · [Usage & limits](usagelimits) · [Other machines](othermachines) · [Privacy](privacy) You start an agent, switch to something else, and ten minutes later wonder: is it done? Is it stuck waiting for approval? Which of the five terminals was it in? hallmonitor answers that at a glance: Who's working, who's idle, who needs you: every Claude Code and Codex session, live. What each one is doing: current tool, last prompt, model, context size, and how many subagents it has running. Across machines: your laptop, dev box and GPU server on one board, over plain SSH. How much you use them: agenthours, tokens, cache hits, plan limits. It only reads. It never sends prompts, approves anything, or talks to your agents. Install brew install hiteshbandhu/tap/hallmonitor the board (macOS, Linux) brew install cask hiteshbandhu/tap/hallmonitorapp menu bar + notch app (macOS 14+) Or download a binary from [Releases](https://github.com/hiteshbandhu/hallmonitor/releases), or build from source with Go 1.26+: go install github.com/hiteshbandhu/hallmonitor/cmd/hallmonitor@latest Then: hallmonitor the board hallmonitor demo a demo fleet, to see it before your agents are running Coming from agentboard? It's the same tool, renamed. brew upgrade moves you over, agentboard still works as a command, and your usage history, hosts and status line carry over on first run. The board [](/hiteshbandhu/hallmonitor/blob/main/docs/demo.png) Cards are grouped into Needs you → Working → Idle. Working cards spin; cards that need you pulse amber and say why (a permission prompt, a question, an error). Each card shows the project, model, context size, current tool, last prompt and a timeline of recent activity, and the waveform up top is your whole fleet over the last few minutes. Key ← ↑ ↓ → move between cards enter open the agent's app (the Claude app on that session, or its terminal) f filter: all / Claude / Codex s show sessions idle for over a day u usage & limits q quit Put it on a second display and leave it there. The app [](/hiteshbandhu/hallmonitor/blob/main/docs/window.png) Open Hall Monitor from the menu bar (⌘O) or the Dock for the full picture in a native window: every agent as a card with what it's doing, its last prompt, subagents and a fiveminute timeline; details in the side panel; Return or a doubleclick jumps to it. Usage charts agent time per day, plan limits, when you work and your top projects, models and tools; Machines shows each SSH host and lets you add or remove them. It's light on your Mac: \~1% CPU in the menu bar, a few percent with the window open. items.author: HiteshBandhu
items.descZh: hallmonitor 是一个用于实时监控编码代理（如 Claude Code 和 Codex）的工具，旨在解决用户在使用代理时因切换任务而遗忘状态的问题。它通过终端、菜单栏和 MacBook 的 Notch 实时显示每个会话的活动，包括代理的工作状态、当前工具、最后提示和上下文大小。亮点在于其极低的资源占用，菜单栏运行时 CPU 使用率仅约 1%，窗口打开时也仅几个百分点，同时采用只读设计，绝不发送提示或批准操作，确保安全。该工具支持跨机器监控，通过 SSH 集成笔记本、开发机和 GPU 服务器，适用于需要同时管理多个编码代理的开发者场景，提升工作效率。
items.quote: 为您的编码代理提供大厅监控：在您的终端、菜单栏和槽口中实时显示每个克劳德编码和Codex会话。
